name: Museo de Arte de Ponce
known: Founded by industrialist Luis A.
A 2010 annex added an education space, library, archives, conservation laboratory, storage area, shop and restaurant (Wikipedia).
Ferré Foundation on 30 June 2022 for conservation capacity at the museum (Mellon Foundation grant page).
Founded by Luis A.

name: Beta-Local
known: Founded in 2009 in San Juan by the artists Beatriz Santiago Muñoz and José "Tony" Cruz and the curator Michy Marxuach, in response to the lack of local contemporary galleries, museums and art schools (e-flux, Marina Reyes Franco, 6 November 2018).
Co-directors listed on the 2025 tax filing: Michael Linares and Pablo Guardiola.

name: Museo de Arte Contemporáneo de Puerto Rico
known: Founded by artists and civil society sponsors and officially instituted as a non-profit on 8 October 1984.
Teiger Foundation: 150,000 dollars for three years of programming by curators Marina Reyes Franco, Abdiel D.
Leadership in the Form 990 for 2025: Marianne Ramirez Aponte, Executive Director;
The 2023 Getty curator grant was a one-off project grant.

name: Smena Centre for Contemporary Culture
known: The co-founder Kirill Maevsky is a publisher and curator, and the artist Robert Khasanov was an early contributor (RBC Style, 2025).

Co-organises the exhibition "На ножках" with the Zarya Center for Contemporary Art in Vladivostok, on show there from 26 September 2026 to 11 April 2027, curated by Aleksandra Paperno and Kirill Maevsky (Zarya).
Co-founder Kirill Maevsky says the centre has never had an annual budget (The Art Newspaper Russia, 15 November 2023).
